entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: This first application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.316/2022 registered at Police Station Kirnapur District Balaghat, for the offence punishable under Sections 21(1), 21(2), 21(3) of Banning of Unregulated Deposit Schemes Act, 2019 and Sections 420, 467 and 468 of IPC.

entities.text: Banning of Unregulated Deposit Schemes Act, 2019
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Counsel for the applicant submits that applicant has falsely been implicated in the alleged offence whereas his role is very nominal in the alleged crime.
He was only an agent and collected the amount from the persons who intended to invest the amount and to get the said amount doubled.
He further submits that looking to the allegation and period of custody bail application of the applicant can be considered.

Raja Sillare vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82154219/
1 P er contra, counsel for State has opposed the submissions made by counsel for the applicant and submitted that bail of main accused and other accused persons have already been rejected by this Court, therefore, at this stage the bail application of the present applicant cannot be allowed.

entities.text: Raja Sillare vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the overall facts and circumstances of this case and the fact that bail of main accused and other co-accused persons have already been rejected, this Court does not deem it appropriate to grant bail to the applicant, at this stage.
Accordingly, the same is hereby rejected.
